agent_guidance.description: Rules and thresholds for an AI agent to evaluate athlete compliance and suggest modifications based on watch data.

pace_zones.note: Trail paces vary widely by terrain and elevation. Use heart rate zones as primary intensity guide; pace as secondary.

easy.description: Conversational effort; can speak in full sentences

long_run.description: Slightly slower than easy; focus on time on feet

tempo.description: Comfortably hard; can speak in short phrases only

hill_repeat.description: Hard uphill effort; recovery jog/walk downhill

strides.description: Short 20-sec bursts at fast but relaxed effort; full recovery between

compliance_rules.action: If actual distance deviates more than 15% from planned, flag for review. Under = possible fatigue or injury. Over = risk of overtraining.

compliance_rules.description: Easy and long runs should stay in zone 1-2
compliance_rules.condition: avg_hr_percent_max > 75 on easy or long_run workouts
compliance_rules.action: Advise athlete to slow down. Running easy runs too fast is the #1 amateur mistake and increases injury risk.

compliance_rules.description: Long run distance should not jump more than ~2 miles week over week (except after cutback)
compliance_rules.exception: Week following a cutback week may increase up to 3 miles
compliance_rules.action: If athlete ran significantly longer than planned, warn about injury risk.

compliance_rules.description: Weekly mileage should not exceed planned by more than 15%
compliance_rules.action: Flag overtraining risk. Suggest reducing an easy run next week.

If missed workout is easy run: no adjustment needed. If missed workout is long run: do NOT try to make it up mid-week; shift to next Monday. If missed hill session: swap one easy run for strides to maintain some intensity.
Repeat the previous week's plan rather than jumping forward. If in taper, continue taper as planned.

compliance_rules.description: Resting heart rate elevated >5 bpm above baseline for 2+ days
compliance_rules.action: Possible overtraining, illness, or under-recovery. Suggest replacing next quality session with easy run or rest day.

compliance_rules.description: Athlete reports pain or watch detects unusual gait/cadence patterns
compliance_rules.action: Reduce volume by 30% for the current week. Replace hill repeats with flat easy runs. If pain persists 3+ days, recommend rest and medical evaluation.
If athlete ran more than planned during a cutback week, advise them that recovery weeks are essential and the next week should not increase from the pre-cutback level.

compliance_rules.description: Long runs should include elevation gain when possible to prepare for race-day 4000 ft
compliance_rules.target: At least 50% of long runs (weeks 5+) should include meaningful elevation
compliance_rules.action: If watch data shows flat long runs for 3+ consecutive weeks, suggest seeking hillier routes.

compliance_rules.description: Race is August 30; summer heat is a factor
compliance_rules.action: If watch data shows high temps (>80F) on workout days, advise: run earlier in the day, reduce pace expectations by 30-60 sec/mile, increase hydration, watch for HR drift (HR climbing at same pace = heat stress).

modification_triggers.feeling_great: If athlete consistently runs faster than easy pace with HR in zone 1-2, they may be fitter than expected. Consider adding 0.5-1 mile to easy runs, but do NOT increase long run distance beyond plan.
modification_triggers.feeling_fatigued: If HR is consistently higher than expected at planned paces, or athlete reports fatigue: reduce easy run distances by 20%, keep long run distance but slow pace, consider extra rest day replacing a strength session.
modification_triggers.time_crunched: If athlete cannot fit all 6 sessions: priority order is (1) Monday long run, (2) Thursday hills/tempo, (3) Friday lower strength, (4) Tuesday easy run, (5) Wednesday upper strength, (6) Saturday easy run.
modification_triggers.weather_disruption: If outdoor running not possible: treadmill with incline is acceptable substitute. Set 4-8% incline for hill sessions. For strength days, no change needed.
